description: This file is a shell script that manages WAN connection setup, specifically for PPPoE protocol. It includes functions for bringing the WAN interface up and down, configuring PPPoE parameters, and handling link state and desired state changes. The script interacts with system configurations, sysctl, and sysevent to control network connectivity.

methods.name: prepare_pppoe
methods.description: Configures PPPoE parameters and prepares the environment for establishing a PPPoE connection.

methods.name: bring_wan_down
methods.description: Disables the WAN connection, stops monitoring, and resets related sysevent tuples and firewall.

methods.name: bring_wan_up
methods.description: Configures and initiates the WAN connection when protocol is PPPoE, setting up necessary scripts and monitoring.
